title: Reject fixed shared-time correction with a bounded full-law test
statement: For the exact sine-source rational replica dimensions n=m^3,d=[(m-1)^2(m+1)]^2,kappa=1/sqrt(d),one common random-time covariance correction has liminf full TV>=v^2/640>0,v=Var_(uniform T)(exp(-1)cosh(T)). Fixed M independent times replace this by v^2/(640M^2). The proof uses the actual four-value action,energy expansion and bounded clipped-square test.

requires: Exactly the named rational replicas and fixed action-count first correction
Fresh secant actions at their actual common time/center
provides: Shared-time fluctuation cannot cancel with baseline energy covariance
Rational quadrature with growing J,m AND zeta->0 removes this component;remaining action variance paid
Growing independent random-time averaging is an equally informed alternative
assumptions: Paid n+1 source cost is still order sqrt(d) on this sequence
Known zero sine mean gives an exact simpler target sampler
Not all allocations,all samplers or an N687 lower bound
costs: Four original values per action;all source replicas retained
Extra quadrature actions O(log^2 d) do not erase replica cost
Missing old quadrature diagnostics do not become observed results
contract.units: Positive asymptotic complete-law TV gap at specified dimensions
contract.obstruction: A fixed shared-time architecture failure,not a hard mean family or universal query advantage for deterministic quadrature.

evidence.range_scope: Actual acquired shared-time energy-test TV lower bound for the named sine dimensions and fixed action count;not all samplers.
Actual rational node/weight acquisition,charged bias/action variance and full-law formula;old cited audit unacquired,new reconstruction separate.

evidence.quote: No core mathematical blocker was found.
evidence.range_scope: Completed same-informed-peer static mathematical/acquisition reconstruction of the exact five proof hashes and both code files;missing historical audits/diagnostics remain unverified.

body: Moment mismatch alone is insufficient. The fourth-moment tail bound makes the clipped energy test bounded and proves a law separation.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
